location: §7 item 1 (same framing in §0 item 7 and the §6.1 bullets on A′)
quote: 1. **The literal conjecture is false in the regime that matters for wide Bayesian learners.** Take any learner that conditions closely on the training outputs: SP$_c$ with $c\ll n^{1-1/H}$, TUBE with $\rho$ below the residual level, or exact interpolation. At width beyond about $n$ it can lose roughly half of the irreducible error, $\beta(\lambda)\,\mathrm{Var}(y\mid x)$ with $\beta\le0.517$, relative to the trivial competitor.
description: The red-team header promises that wherever a later note settled or corrected a statement, an 'At finalization' note says so. The status table lists only §7 items 3, 5 and 6 as amended, so item 1 has no note, although A corrects it on two counts. First, A §0.1, §5.4 and §10, and README §3 ('It refutes particular learners, not the conjecture'), say that Claim A refutes (P_L) only for SP_c with cK_mem=o(n), at N≥N_0 on laws with d=log_2 n, and that the conjecture is not refuted, since B's tempered learner has (P_L). Second, A §0.1 says 'TUBE_ρ does not fail by memorizing noise': its posterior is undefined for ρ≤1 once an atom carries both labels (Lemma 6.4), and for ρ>1 it is centred at the label midrange (Propositions 6.3, 6.6, 6.6a). The β(λ) loss is proved for SP_c only, and exact interpolation is undefined on repeated atoms with conflicting labels. Only §0 item 1 has a note explaining in what sense the conjecture is 'refuted'. §0 item 7 ('The conjecture still fails with deterministic labels, …') and §6.1 ('Versions that still fail', citing red-team's own Proposition 2.4) use the same framing without one. A reader is misled about what is refuted.
suggested_fix: Append to §7 item 1: "[At finalization: in the terms of `A-tight-conditioning-fails.md` (its §0.1 and §5.4), this refutes the property (P$_L$) for SP$_c$ with $cK_{\rm mem}=o(n)$, at learner widths $N\ge N_0={\rm poly}(n)$ on laws whose dimension $d=\log_2n$ grows, not the conjecture, which `B-tempered-likelihood.md` satisfies with tempered $c$ for clipped predictions. The loss $\beta(\lambda)\mathrm{Var}(y\mid x)$ is proved for SP$_c$ only. TUBE$_\rho$ fails for a different reason: for $\rho\le1$ its posterior is undefined once an atom carries both labels, and for $\rho>1$ it centres its outputs at the midrange of the labels (A Lemma 6.4 and Propositions 6.3, 6.6 and 6.6a).]" Add to §0 item 7 and the §6.1 heading: "[At finalization: 'fails' is meant as in the note on item 1; A′ is proved in A Theorem 7.2 and Corollary 7.2b.]" List §7 item 1 as amended in the status table and the record.

quote: and, for the strong prior at small $\sigma$, bounds the posterior expected loss of the clipped outputs by $(\tau+\rho_0)^2+4\varepsilon/3$ at the polynomial sample size of the continuous-domain paper's Theorem `strong`.
description: The remark describes red-team Proposition 4.1 as it was before finalization. The finalized proposition has three parts: (a) min{4,(τ+ρ_0)²}+4ε/3; (b) the sharper ρ²+ε, at a sample size that depends neither on ρ, ρ_0, τ nor on N (the bound README §2 and §8 cite); (c) an energy statement. A quotes only (a). Its sentence 'Its statement that such conditioning never memorizes holds only in the energy sense.' refers to a sentence red-team.md no longer contains (red-team's record, point 6(d)). Its tightness example also omits the qualifier the finalized proposition states: it holds on samples that contain a label −c_0, which have probability 1−p^n.
suggested_fix: Replace with: "… bounds the posterior expected loss of the clipped outputs by $\min\{4,(\tau+\rho_0)^2\}+4\varepsilon/3$ (its part (a)) and, at a sample size polynomial in $d,C,B,1/\varepsilon,\log(1/\delta)$ that does not depend on $\rho,\rho_0,\tau$ or $N$, by $\rho^2+\varepsilon$ (its part (b)). Its part (c) keeps the posterior at energy at most $E_*+2$ for every $n$, so it excludes memorization only in the energy sense." Delete the 'never memorizes' sentence. In the example add "on samples that contain a label $-c_0$ (probability $1-p^n$)". Make the no-conflict sentence also cover part (b): with ρ>ρ_0≥1, ρ²+ε>1≥L_D(0).
